scope: Full 11 turns and five goals of 16 current Ishioka and Yuki scripts; causal/location-role/closure batch, not whole-prefecture semantic approval.

findings.reason: Loose numbering paper could detach from photographs after shuffling. Each photograph now has its own closed transparent sleeve numbered to match the explanation sheet; all six are checked before packaging.
Removed unnatural NPC reference to a learning-only shop; fictional scope stays in metadata.

judgments.Ishioka: Flower water upright handling and time margin; volunteering limited time and task ownership; unmeasured data distinguished from repeated readings; observed visitor facts versus inferred occupation; photo identification repaired; old/new bankbook date coverage; discount eligibility versus preference; drawing stays on own paper and does not chase moving shadow. No additional causal blocker identified.
judgments.Yuki: Vending purchase evidence and one transaction; current reservations separated from improvement request; selected stair photograph supplemented by movement description; bag contents confidence and followup; readable shipping label avoids opening tab; bank document search preserves possessions and active queue status; uncut purchased leek packing separated from eggs; scattered pencils secured before collection, counted and incomplete search reported.

pending: 192 Ibaraki scripts remain in this whole-prefecture causal pass; cross-prefecture comparison is not complete.
